normal.name: Quester the Quester ⛅
normal.text: #FFIX #VideoGames I went around the entire Forgotten Continent, thinking there was a mountain terrain from the sea to the continent to gain access with Choco. Nope. No idea how to get to it when the Chocograph says all you need are the field, reef, mountain and sea abilities. So I try to consult a guide. Or ten. Not a single one of them mentions that you do need a flying ship to get to the continent even with the chocobo. FFS…
